en.title: Backend Developer
en.stack: Node.js, NestJS, .NET Core, AWS, REST APIs, Microservices, API Gateway, Docker, Kubernetes

items: Built backend services with Node.js and NestJS, and some with .NET Core, focused on performance and fast responses to the frontend.
Designed REST APIs for the clients and for integrating third-party services.
Built microservices with Docker, orchestrated with Kubernetes, to isolate responsibilities and improve fault tolerance.
Routed requests through API Gateway, keeping service delivery secure and consistent.
Implemented and managed the cloud infrastructure on AWS.
